about_the_game:
This demo takes you back to where it all started: Chapter 0, Midnight Gold Rush, the job that set the Goldmans’ fate in motion.

You'll step into the boots of Cole, the father, in a flashback sequence that captures the calm before everything fell apart. What starts as a meticulously planned bank heist quickly spirals into chaos, blending stealth, tension, and a hail of gunfire.

This vertical slice showcases the gritty tone, comic book styling, and moment-to-moment intensity that define Bullet Ballet. Some features from the full game like Ballet Mode, different environments, and Johnny's side of the story are not present in the demo. Instead, this is your chance to feel the risk behind every breath, and the price of a perfect plan gone wrong.

Classic Wild West Atmosphere

Feel the dust under your boots and the weight of your revolver. Dive into a richly crafted Wild West world filled with memorable characters, vast deserts, and outlaw towns. Every corner of this world captures the essence of a time when law was scarce, and danger was everywhere. 

Comic Book Aesthetic

 Ever dreamed of stepping into the pages of a cowboy comic book? With a unique blend of nostalgia and modern twists, this game brings the iconic Wild West comics to life, but with a fresh, contemporary edge.

Hand-Painted Visuals

Every scene feels like it was torn from the pages of a comic book. The game's hand-drawn 2D visuals are carefully crafted to enhance immersion, perfectly meshing with the post-processing effects to create a stylized but cohesive world.

Stealth-Driven GameplayBegin underground and move in silence. Use knives, fists, or a broken bottle. The first floor isn’t built for gunfire, and the shadows are your only friends.

Environmental ExecutionYour surroundings are just as deadly as your weapons. Drop chandeliers, light dynamite, and turn a polished bank into a warzone.

content_descriptors.notes: This demo contains stylized comic book violence, blood, frequent profanity, and themes of revenge. Players can smoke cigarettes. There is no sexual content. The game does not depict self-harm, non-consensual acts, or substance abuse beyond smoking.

short_description: Bullet Ballet is a Wild West action FPS game that follows John Maxwell Goldman, a man searching for answers and his missing father. Set in the unforgiving frontier, this comic book-inspired journey places the fate of a father and son in the hands of the Wild West.
